home.title: Backend Developer & IT Technician
home.subtitle: Building backend systems, managing Linux infrastructure, and solving technical problems. Focused on APIs, authentication systems, servers, and IT operations.

about.bio1: I'm a Backend Developer and IT Technician. My backend work focuses on API development, authentication and authorization, database management, and server-side system design. I work with TypeScript, Laravel, Rust, and other backend technologies. On the IT side, I have hands-on experience with hardware and software troubleshooting, network configuration, device maintenance, and Linux and Windows system administration.
about.bio2: Outside of work, I enjoy exploring Linux, building home servers, experimenting with self-hosted applications, and making the most of available hardware. I like understanding how systems work, identifying root causes, and finding practical solutions. Open to backend development, IT support, technical operations, and project collaborations.

todo.title: Todo List Application
todo.description: A task management application with guest mode and user authentication. Features a GraphQL API, OAuth, email and password login, CRUD operations, and cross-device data synchronization.

blog.title: Blog Application
blog.description: A content publishing platform integrated with a GraphQL API. Includes role-based access control, an administration panel, and Markdown support for content management.
